About Desert Luxury Camp
Morocco Luxury Desert Camps Like No Other
When it comes to premium escapes in Morocco’s Sahara Desert, Desert Luxury Camps offers the kind of trips that turn dreams into reality. Our Erg Chebbi luxury desert camp near Merzouga and Erg Chigaga luxury desert camp by M’Hamid provide exceptional accommodation and experiences in the heart of the dunes, including en suite bathrooms, air conditioning at night, guided camel rides, sand boarding, and much more.
Whichever of our luxury desert camps in Morocco you prefer, we can help you have the trip of a lifetime. Our team of experienced travel specialists is a blend of local and international experts, the perfect mix for delivering the complete Sahara Desert experience.
Get to know our team a little better below — and let’s start planning your Morocco luxury holiday package ! Have any questions for us? Please just get in touch for all the answers you need.
Meet the Team Behind Our Luxury Desert Camps in Morocco
Abdou
Abdou grew up in one of the Sub-Saharan Berber villages in the Draa Valley. He came from a large family and has great experience working with tourists as a camel guide, later as a driver, and more recently running a tour operator company. He got to know Hamid (more on him below!) while working together in tourism. They became close friends and made their dream come true… building the magnificent “oasis” in the Erg Chebbi sand dunes.
Hamid
Hamid grew up in the sand dunes of Erg Chebbi, so he knows these enormous formations like the back of his hand. He has significant experience organizing camel treks and was responsible for many desert camps in the area. But he started to feel sad that the desert was becoming too busy, too full of people. This feeling was his inspiration for developing luxury camps that offer the peace, stillness, and solitude that the desert should, but with all the experiences that make trips to the Sahara so memorable.
Jana
Jana grew up in the Czech Republic, behind the curtain of the regime. She dreamt of all the different countries, languages, and cultures people could immerse themselves in around the world. Since she was 18 years old, Jana has traveled and lived in many countries, from the United Kingdom and France to Canada and the United States. She settled in Morocco, a special country that she loves, particularly the southern region. For Jana, it has a truly special vibe in its varied and beautiful landscapes as well as the friendliest people in Morocco.
Zaid
Zaid has lived his entire life in M’hamid, a small town on the edge of the Sahara dunes of Erg Chigaga. Behind the homes here, the road finishes and stretches for kilometers of endless deserts.
It’s no exaggeration to say that the desert is in Zaid’s blood. He started working in tourism at the age of 14 years old, guiding tourists into the desert dunes on camel caravans. Later, he worked with many camps and also established his own standard camp. Zaid has known Abdou since childhood and, following the success of the Erg Chebbi luxury desert camp near Merzouga, they decided to set up a similar camp in Erg Chigaga . To this day there is no other camp in the area with running water in the bathrooms – ours is the only one!
Zaid and Abdou know the desert well and have the greatest appreciation for it, especially the untamed wilderness of Erg Chigaga.

Culinary
Part of the experience in staying in our camp is to enjoy meals that are prepared with special care.
We have kitchen on the property so all meals are prepared fresh before your arrival from local produced ingredients. We are employing chef that is experienced and learn the art of cooking in one of the culinary schools in Marrakech.
Dinners are always a 3 -courses feast including salads or/and soups, main meal Moroccan typical dish such as different types of tajin, lamb mechoui or seven vegetable couscous followed by desert that is assortment of seasonal fruit and/or pastry.
Breakfast is wide variety of different jams, cheeses, oils, honey. We always offer yogurts and different types of Moroccan pancakes. Often fresh bake bread is serve with your breakfast. Eggs are prepared by order and of course freshly squeezed orange juice and coffee and tea are part of the desert breakfast.
Lunch generally serve as picnic is rather light and includes salad, brochettes or grilled chicken and seasonal fruit.
Since we have kitchen on the property we can tailor to any dietary requirements you might have from vegetarian to gluten free. We also provide on request children meals from pizzas to pasta dishes. If you are celebrating birthdays or honeymoons and like to get cake prepared for you, please let us know in advance.
Dinner can be served either under the stars or in the dining tent, breakfast is served under the morning sun. Don t forget that cold drinks are always available.
If you like to come only for lunch let us know it can certainly be arranged.
Ecology
We are learning about how to be the most ecological to the natural environment but we already take the following steps to ensure conscious tourism without leaving negative impact on the environment:
Leaving no trace of any garbage/waste behind. There are garbage bins around the camp and we ensure that nothing is left in any surrounding areas
We recycle plastic bottles
Vegetable, fruit scraps and left over meals, bread are used for animals, camels in the camp or given to Nomads living in the area
Solar energy power is used in the camp
Hammam bathroom towels (quick to dry and low water consumption)
We use the filtered water in glass bottles
Use of plastic bottle water is used minimally and always recycled

FAQ About Our Morocco Luxury Desert Camps & Packages
At Desert Luxury Camps, we understand that multi-day Sahara experiences are usually bucket-list trips. It’s only natural, then, that you want as much peace of mind as possible before making your booking. As you would expect from the leader in Morocco luxury holiday packages , the Desert Luxury Camp team is here to help however we can. That’s why we have answered some of the most frequently asked questions we receive below.
Simply read through the questions and find out if we’ve answered any pre-booking queries you have. And if we haven’t, please just get in touch for all the answers you need!
FAQs before booking FAQs on our Desert Camps
FAQ Before Booking Your Morocco Luxury Holiday Package
What forms of payments do you accept?
We accept PayPal, bank transfers, and credit cards, including American Express.
Is a two-night minimum stay required?
No, we don’t implement a two-night minimum stay. However, we recommend this to fully appreciate the camp and its beautiful desert surroundings.
Are you open year-round?
Yes, we are. But please note, in the summer months (end of June to August), we only keep 5 tents open for bookings.
What is the best time of year to visit?
Every individual will find personal pros and cons for visiting in certain seasons.
If we had to recommend a generally preferred time of year that most guests love, we would say March to May and the end of September to November.
Winter months (December to January) have very cold nights. But our camps have heating to maintain the expected standard of comfort.
What is your cancellation policy?
We require a deposit of 25% to secure your booking. The remaining balance can be paid upon arrival at the camp.
If you need to cancel your booking, the following cancellation fees apply:
31 days or more before arrival: Full refund
30 to 21 days before arrival: 30% cancellation fee
20 to 14 days before arrival: 60% cancellation fee
13 to 7 days before arrival: 80% cancellation fee
6 days before arrival through to no-show: 100% cancellation fee
All cancellations must be submitted and confirmed in writing via email.
Please note that any bank or credit card transaction fees are non-refundable.
What is there to do if I stay more than one night?
We have designed the camp so you have plenty of things to do if staying more than one night.
First of all, we have equipped tents with hot showers, flushing toilets, and comfortable medical bedding for a good night’s sleep, so you won’t be wanting for comfort.
In addition, there are areas and activities set up for you to enjoy. You can go on camel rides, sandboard on desert dunes, take guided walking tours, visit Nomads, and play handballs and table games.
If you are adventurous enough to try the sand hammam – you can even bury yourself completely in the sand.
There are many areas spread around both camps where you can relax and absorb the desert landscape. Stays are all-inclusive, so ice-cold, non-alcoholic beverages and all meals are included, as are many of the activities too.
What is the weather like? Does it get cold at night?
This depends on the time of year you visit.
Winter months – nice and pleasant, warm and sunny days. But the nights and early mornings are cold, so be prepared for low temperatures. We provide electrical or gas heaters in the tents, as well as water bottles and/or electrical heating blankets for beds.
Spring months – Longer days that become warmer. Nights are much more comfortable and, generally speaking, by the end of March to early April, tents no longer need heating. Sandstorms can appear during this time of the year. In May and June, it starts to get really hot.
Fall months – Warm days and nights. Sunny blue skies. October to November is probably one of the best periods for gorgeous weather.
If we want to book a package desert tour, is there an ideal amount of days?
The more days you have for your luxury desert tour, the better it is. The minimum we would recommend is 3 days, but having 4 or 5 days is much better to fully appreciate the desert tour experience in Morocco.
What happens if the weather turns bad?
The weather in the Sahara is unpredictable. It’s not unusual for sand storms to happen from time to time.
But our tents are built to sustain heavy winds. One of the restaurants at the camp is built from clay bricks, so it offers great shelter if you should get caught in very bad weather.
We have a great relationship with numerous hotels in the Merzouga area so, in the worst-case scenario, we can substitute your night with one of the hotels.
Can you pick up from Errachidia airport even late at night upon landing?
Yes, we can meet you at Errachidia airport at any time, even late in the evening when the flight from Casablanca lands.
It is a safe drive, even at night, and we will provide a light dinner upon arrival at the camp.
What happens to my luggage?
Transfers to the camp are provided by 4x4WD and all your luggage is taken directly to the camp.
FAQ About Our Morocco Luxury Desert Camps
How well-located are your luxury desert camps?
Location is one of our desert camps’ greatest assets.
Merzouga and the desert dunes of Erg Chebbi are extremely crowded with too many camps. Unfortunately, It is not regulated.
Our location is the best in the entire Merzouga area.
We are set deep inside the desert with no other camps in close proximity. You can walk for miles before encountering any other sign of life.
Is it safe?
We believe that no place is safer than the desert, especially in today’s world where anything or anyone can be targeted.
The desert is a vast open space with great visibility and a limited amount of life, so there’s hardly anyone to target.

Our Range of Luxury Vacations in Morocco
Are you looking for Southern Morocco luxury holiday packages that include experiences in the Sahara? Let Desert Luxury Camp help with the planning and execution. With our Morocco trip packages, we cover everything from start to finish. This includes collecting you from anywhere in Morocco and providing private transportation to our luxury desert camps at Erg Chebbi and Erg Chigaga. Booking one of our Morocco luxury holiday packages  is often more advantageous and convenient than booking the camp separately, but not required.
If you prefer, you can travel in a small rented car to Merzouga or M’hamid where we’ll meet you in a 4x4WD for the final leg of the journey. For more specific details or to discuss tailored itineraries for luxury vacations in Morocco , please don’t hesitate to contact us .
Read about our M orocco luxury desert camp experiences and find out more about the adventures waiting for you here! Scroll down to find a sample selection of our most popular packages for luxury vacations in Morocco.
Luxury Morocco Trip Packages from Fes
Fes is closer to the Erg Chebbi dunes near Merzouga, so it’s well-connected for a desert tour. These Morocco luxury holiday packages start in Fes and end in Marrakech. Alternatively, you can also take tours in the reverse direction if you prefer. Discover more about our Erg Chebbi luxury desert camp .
When you leave the crowded, bustling city of Fes behind, you’ll be amazed by the nature you encounter in the desert. This is one of our favorite drives in Morocco, and it makes a great addition to luxury vacations in Morocco.
View Our Tours
Morocco Luxury Holiday Packages from Marrakech
If you are setting out for a desert adventure from Marrakech, both Erg Chebbi and Erg Chigaga are within easy reach. Erg Chigaga is closer to Marrakech and takes around 7 to 8 hours to reach by car. The drive to Erg Chebbi is slightly longer at 9 to 10 hours.
However, the drive through the ever-changing desert landscape is a truly spectacular part of our l uxury vacations in Morocco and provides a tempting sample of what lies ahead! Find out more about our Erg Chigaga luxury desert camp .
View Our Tours
Luxury Morocco Trip Packages from Other Cities
When you book one of our Morocco luxury holiday packages, we can arrange a desert tour starting from any other city too, not just Fes or Marrakech. If you need to be picked up in Agadir, Casablanca, or somewhere else, please let us know and we’ll send the best possible option for you.
In some cases, we may also include domestic flights on Royal Air Maroc to ease the distance of travel. Our luxury vacations in Morocco are all about making everything as smooth and convenient as possible.
View Our Tours
Luxury Vacations in Morocco Make Incredible Honeymoons
Your wedding day will be one of the most special and memorable days of your life — and your honeymoon deserves the same treatment. At Desert Luxury Camp, we can create a bespoke honeymoon package in Morocco that you’ll never forget.
Our team has significant experience crafting luxury vacations in Morocco, so please just let us know your requirements and we’ll take care of everything.
Contact Us
Custom Morocco Luxury Holiday Packages
Having traveled the country extensively, Jana and Abdou at Desert Luxury Camp know Morocco inside out. You can rely on us for custom Morocco tour itineraries that suit your needs perfectly. All you need to do is let us know the kind of adventure you want to have, and we can tailor a trip that ticks every box.
We can help you with hotel and riad arrangements or, if you prefer, you can reserve them yourself. Whichever option you choose, you can count on us for private transportation with an experienced driver. Every aspect of our service is designed to make dream luxury vacations in Morocco a reality.
